newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Bozano Simonsen to open London brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Bozano Simonsen to open London brokerage.

text.p: Brazilian investment bank Bozano Simonsen said it will open in January a brokerage house in London to provide services for its British and Scottish clients.
The new brokerage is expected to have a total capital of $20 million by June of next year, said a spokesman for the bank.

He noted the brokerage in London is another step toward globalizing the firm's operations. Last year, the bank opened a brokerage house in New York, Bozano Simonsen Securities, which currently has a net worth of $42 million.
